blocks.text: Make room. Listen to the Word.
Listen to the complete Bible, or explore selected recordings from Streetlights.
The whole Word. At your own pace.
The American Standard Version, read by Ron Altman. A complete, freely available Bible to listen to here, from Genesis to Revelation.
These selections come from Streetlights’ audio Bible visualizers on YouTube. Each book opens its own recording.
We love how Streetlights’ cadence and rhythm bring emphasis to the letters and give Revelation’s vivid imagery room to resonate.
The musical setting feels at home with the poetry of Psalms and the memorable wisdom of Proverbs, inviting us to linger with the words.
Letters of faith, grace, and everyday discipleship. Take time to hear the whole book.
Full playlists include books beyond the selections above.
A steady, non-dramatized reading for time spent listening to Scripture.
A dramatized recording for listeners who enjoy a more expressive telling.
Rooted in Scripture. Open for discovery.
A place to read slowly, ask deeply, and follow the connections. Scripture, study and the voices of Christian history, brought together for a lifetime of learning.
A library with a paper trail.
Meet the authors. Explore the collection. Trace each work to its source.
